Research information

Research, Sources & Corrections Policy

How to interpret TickerLantern source dates, financial research, hypothetical scenarios, model limits and corrections.

These principles describe how to read and assess research published on TickerLantern.

Sources and dates

Prefer the original official publication for the fact being discussed. Retrieval time, source observation date and article publication date describe different events. A successful refresh does not turn an older observation into current data. Dated or unavailable inputs retain their qualifications.

Facts, calculations and scenarios

Source-reported observations, calculations derived from them and hypothetical assumptions must be distinguishable. Source references support only the claims they actually contain. Interactive results depend on the selected inputs, timing conventions and model limits; they do not establish a probability or a fair value unless a separately described model supports that interpretation.

Financial planning and product research

Tax, benefit, legal and product rules can change. Check the current official source and the applicable issuer documents before making a decision. Examples do not assess a reader’s full circumstances or replace advice from an appropriately qualified professional. Product availability and executable prices are not established by a research page.

Limitations and source rights

Missing coverage, incompatible definitions and conditional estimates belong beside the relevant result. Original third-party source documents and raw private research files are not part of this website’s publication. Links to a source do not imply its endorsement or permission for further redistribution.

Report a correction

Email support@tickerlantern.com with the affected page, the disputed statement and an official reference if available. Corrections should identify the affected claim and preserve the distinction between a changed source observation and a calculation error. Do not include private client or account records.
